insights.text: The GMK Tech Evo X2, a mini PC with 128GB of RAM and AMD's Ryzen AI Max Plus 395 processor, offers significant capabilities for running local Large Language Models (LLMs). When choosing a mini-PC for local LLM processing, consider the Evo X2 as a powerful alternative to devices like the DJX Spark and the M4 Mac Mini.

Terranova, led by Laurence Allen, is addressing flooding by lifting land using a wood chip slurry injection method. This innovative approach presents a cost-effective alternative to traditional flood mitigation strategies.
